summary: Examples check whether /etc/hosts exists and select only existing local files from a list to copy.
questions: How do I copy only files that exist locally from a list?

answer_card.title: exists test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
vars:
  my_etc_hosts_exists: "{{ '/etc/hosts' is exists }}"
  list_of_local_files_to_copy_to_remote: "{{ list_of_all_possible_files | select('exists') }}"
```
